# Contributing

English · Türkçe: [docs/tr/CONTRIBUTING.md](../docs/tr/CONTRIBUTING.md)

Thanks for helping! Keep it simple:

1. Open an issue first for bigger changes so we can agree on the idea.
2. Fork, make a branch, make your change. Keep changes small and focused.
3. Run `npm install` then `npm test`; all tests must pass. Build steps: see [BUILD.md](../BUILD.md).
4. Open a pull request and fill in the template.

Project rules: no network calls, no reading game memory, no code injection, no global keyboard hooks. Contributions are licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
